# Where this stands (2026-11-08, ~11 PM US Eastern)

**Read first:** `docs/RESULTS.md` (all valid experiments, generated by `python src/report.py verl`),
`docs/IDEAS.md` (the credit-assignment ideas and the offline evidence behind them), `docs/DECISIONS.md`
(every judgement call, with measurements; "Attempt 4" onward is the current setup).

## Setup
Experiments run on **verl-agent** (`/workspace/verl-agent`, own venv, our changes in
`verl/verl-agent.patch` on top of `verl/VERL_AGENT_COMMIT`) on one A100 40 GB, with the paper's
prompt/response format, full fine-tuning, all six ALFWorld task types and the same 128 validation
games for every arm. Arms are launched by `verl/run_arms.sh <arm>` (one at a time), run exactly 34 iterations each (no
wall-clock cap), and differ only in `algorithm.gaca.*`. The instance has **no persistent volume**: the branch `a100` is mirrored to the
private HF repo `Adammouedden/gaca-term-project` by `verl/hf_backup.sh` (HF token in `models/token`,
git-ignored). Final probe weights go to the private `Adammouedden/gaca-term-checkpoints`.

## Done
Controls GRPO (14.1%) and GACA (18.8%, p=0.26 vs GRPO); treatments GACA + m_z (12.5%) and GACA-LOO
(11.7%); base model 4.7%. Offline: GACA's step score is ~85% within-state noise; entropy token
weighting does not track decision importance; the **commitment probe** does (1.65x [1.57, 1.74] at the
training config, consistent across task types and game halves).

## Running / queued (automatic)
1. `gaca_probe` (seed 0): GACA + probe-weighted token credit, 34 iterations, ends ~1:15 AM Eastern.
2. `verl/launch_probe_s1.sh`: smoke-tests the final-weights save+upload, then `gaca_probe_s1` (seed 1,
   same validation games, final bf16 weights uploaded), ends ~7 AM Eastern.
3. `verl/report_after_probe.sh`: regenerates docs/RESULTS.md, commits, pushes and backs up after each probe arm.

probe as the step gate (idea 2), both (idea 3), tighter clip [0.5, 2] if KL/instability shows up.
